system.description: This threat has some sort of visible mechanical and electronic parts. Build from heroes successfully Attacked by Skeeterbots in Scene 1. (1 per DNA-sampled hero of matching archetype.)
system.tactics: Mimic the copied hero; choose two abilities from the listed options, or make one up that mimics something the hero is good at.

system.description: Choose two abilities: Learning Machine: Boost yourself. The bonus is persistent and exclusive. | Metallic Resilience: Reduce all damage taken by 1. | Precision Weaponry: +1 to Attack actions.
